found_during: user reported live, mid-session, watching VTID-04102's fix confirmed working: renamed a task title, then the Operator Console showed the still-running Dev Autopilot execution (22cbc22f, VTID-04103) as if it had stopped
root_cause: switchOperatorThread() and initOperatorChatSession() (page-load bootstrap) both rebuild state.chatMessages from the persisted state.operatorChatHistory, which only ever stored {role, content, ts} — followExecIds (VTID-04033) was set only on the in-memory-only state.chatMessages push in sendChatMessage(), never persisted, so a thread switch or reload permanently lost the live follow panel for a still-running execution

live_evidence.conclusion: backend never stopped; the defect is purely client-side display state

fix: app.js sendChatMessage(): followExecIds now persisted on assistantHistoryEntry (var turnFollowExecIds computed once, reused for both the persisted history entry and the in-memory chatMessages push)
app.js: new reattachFollowedExecutions(chatMessages) helper — reopens followOperatorExecution(execId) for every restored message's followExecIds
app.js switchOperatorThread(): carries followExecIds through history.map(), closes the outgoing thread's follows first, reattaches the incoming thread's follows
app.js initOperatorChatSession(): same restore-and-reattach on page-load bootstrap

verification.mutation_result: reverting app.js reproduces the exact reported symptom: 4/5 new tests fail (no persisted followExecIds, no reattach wiring in either restore function)
